keyPoints: Checklist tasks keep an append-only log of done dates instead of per-day snapshots, so nothing carries over between days
Daily links keep one config row plus one row per day of opened-link flags, in the same table
Card scheduling is a pure function, so the SM-2-style model can be swapped without touching storage
Provisioned by azure-infrastructure modules/dailyapi.bicep on FC1, because a new Linux Y1 plan is refused in this resource group
architecture.overview: Azure Functions Python v2 programming model on a Flex Consumption (FC1) plan. One HTTP trigger per route under /api/daily/, plus an unauthenticated /api/health. Data lives in three Table Storage tables (DailyChecklist, DailyLinks, DailyCards) in the app's own storage account. Auth is in application code: each request's Bearer token is verified with google-auth against GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, then checked against ALLOWED_WRITERS.

dataFlow.label: User opens /today, signed in with Google
daily-api verifies the token and the ALLOWED_WRITERS allowlist
sublines: reads DailyChecklist, DailyLinks, DailyCards (partition = user email)

dataFlow.label: User toggles a task, opens a link, or grades a card
POST to the matching /api/daily/* route; review grades reschedule the card

description: Azure Functions (Python) API behind my-website's /today page: a recurring daily checklist, a curated set of daily links, and spaced-repetition review cards. Split out of posts-api on 2026-10-22, with its own storage account and its own Google ID token auth.
features: Daily checklist: list and create recurring tasks (optional expires_after), toggle a task done for a given day
Daily links: GET/PUT the link config, record and list which links were opened on a given day
Review cards: create a card (text plus optional back), list cards due on a date, grade a review (again/hard/good/easy), delete a card
SM-2-style scheduling: the ease factor moves per grade (floored at 1.3) and "again" resets the interval to 1 day
Per-user data: every table is partitioned by the signed-in user's email
Google ID token auth, plus an ALLOWED_WRITERS allowlist when that setting is non-empty
role: Backs /today: daily checklist, daily links, and review cards

sections.content: Function App daily-api-prod-hwbxtkz6lsfoq runs on Flex Consumption (FC1): Python 3.12, up to 40 instances, 2048 MB per instance. Its own storage account (dailyapihwbxtkz6lsfoq) holds the DailyChecklist, DailyLinks and DailyCards tables. Infrastructure is defined in [[azure-infrastructure|azure-infrastructure]]'s modules/dailyapi.bicep. GitHub Actions runs pytest on every PR and push to main; pushes to main then deploy with `func azure functionapp publish --python`, signed in as the daily-api-deploy service principal, which has Website Contributor on this one app only. Request telemetry goes to Application Insights (daily-api-prod-insights), backed by the daily-api-prod-logs Log Analytics workspace.

sections.content: The daily checklist, links and cards routes originally lived in [[posts-api|posts-api]], on tables in posts-api's storage account. On 2026-10-22 they moved to this service, and the existing rows were copied into daily-api's own storage account. [[my-website|my-website]]'s /today page now calls daily-api through REACT_APP_DAILY_API_BASE_URL, and posts-api's daily routes, its azure-data-tables dependency and its DAILY_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING setting were removed.
